## What changes for the user?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## Verification

Link the GitHub Actions run and relevant results. State the requested scope (docs-only, Quick with explicit targets, or Full with a reason) and any unverified scenarios. Automated tests and builds run in CI, not locally.

For UI changes, include relevant screenshots and keyboard behavior when available.

## Before review

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no private data, credentials or generated build output.
- [ ] Existing tests were reused; new tests cover a real behavior or risk where needed.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and third-party notices are updated, or no update is needed.

An independent reviewer must approve the change and required checks must pass before merge.
